Actual Article Body:
Democratic Texas State Rep. Gina Hinojosa ripped former President Joe Biden’s approach to his immigration policy in an interview this week, saying his policies on illegal immigration hurt Democrats in the 2024 election cycle.

“Biden’s problem is he didn’t lead on immigration,” Hinojosa said in an interview with Politico. “He was silent mostly. He hid from it, and that did hurt us last election cycle. It hurt all Democrats.”
